from pathlib import Path
from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
from fractions import Fraction
from itertools import combinations
import csv,gzip,hashlib,json,math
base=Path("benchmark_tools/results/native_factorial_fas_sampling_20261010_v1")
report=json.loads((base/"report.json").read_text())
def distribution(M,G,c):
 lo,hi=max(0,c-M+G),min(c,G)
 mode=max(lo,min(hi,((c+1)*(G+1))//(M+2)))
 q={mode:Decimal(1)}
 for t in range(mode,hi):
  q[t+1]=q[t]*Decimal((G-t)*(c-t))/Decimal((t+1)*(M-G-c+t+1))
 for t in range(mode,lo,-1):
  q[t-1]=q[t]*Decimal(t*(M-G-c+t))/Decimal((G-t+1)*(c-t+1))
 total=sum(q.values())
 return {t:v/total for t,v in q.items()}
def weight(M,G,c,k):
 return sum(p*Decimal(k)/Decimal(k+t) for t,p in distribution(M,G,c).items())
with localcontext() as ctx:
 ctx.prec=80
 toy=distribution(4,2,2)
 assert max(abs(toy[t]-Decimal(x.numerator)/Decimal(x.denominator)) for t,x in enumerate([Fraction(1,6),Fraction(2,3),Fraction(1,6)])) < Decimal("1e-70")
 assert abs(weight(4,2,2,2)-Decimal(25)/36) < Decimal("1e-70")
 delta=Decimal(1)/240
 numerical_errors=[];checked=[];projected=[]
 for row in report["methods"]:
  M,c,k,r,P=(row[x] for x in ("M","c","k","r","P"))
  gl,gh=row["interval"]["success_count_bounds"]
  tail_lo=sum(p for t,p in distribution(M,gl,c).items() if t>=r)
  tail_hi=sum(p for t,p in distribution(M,gh,c).items() if t<=r)
  assert tail_lo>=delta/2 and tail_hi>=delta/2
  if gl>r: assert sum(p for t,p in distribution(M,gl-1,c).items() if t>=r)<delta/2
  if gh<M-c+r: assert sum(p for t,p in distribution(M,gh+1,c).items() if t<=r)<delta/2
  sums=[Decimal(0),Decimal(0)]; n=0
  with gzip.open(row["raw"]["path"],"rt") as stream:
   reader=csv.reader(stream,delimiter="\t");assert next(reader)==["Acc1","Acc2","FAS"]
   for _,_,value in reader:
    sums[0 if n<k else 1]+=Decimal(value);n+=1
  assert n==k+r
  a,b=sums[0]/k,sums[1]/r
  z=(sums[0]+sums[1])/(k+r)
  numerical_errors += [abs(a-Decimal(str(row["precomputed_sample_mean"]))),abs(b-Decimal(str(row["returned_sample_mean"]))),abs(z-Decimal(str(row["observed_native_mean"])))]
  h_old=((Decimal(2)/delta).ln()/(2*k)).sqrt()
  h_new=((Decimal(2)/delta).ln()/(2*r)).sqrt()
  old=[max(Decimal(0),a-h_old),min(Decimal(1),a+h_old)]
  new=[max(Decimal(0),b-h_new),min(Decimal(1),b+h_new)]
  if k==P:old=[a,a]
  weights=[weight(M,g,c,k) for g in (gl,gh)]
  corners=[w*x+(1-w)*y for w in weights for x in old for y in new]
  bounds=[min(corners),max(corners)]
  for actual,expected in ((old,row["interval"]["precomputed_mean_bounds"]),(new,row["interval"]["return_mean_bounds"]),(bounds,row["interval"]["expected_native_mean_bounds"])):
   numerical_errors.extend(abs(x-Decimal(str(y))) for x,y in zip(actual,expected))
  projected.append((row["cell"],bounds))
  checked.append(dict(cell=row["cell"],G_bounds=[gl,gh],lower_tail=str(tail_lo),upper_tail=str(tail_hi),raw_scores=n,theta_bounds=list(map(str,bounds))))
 for (ln,lb),(rn,rb) in combinations(projected,2):
  found=[v for v in report["contrasts"] if v["left"]==ln and v["right"]==rn]
  assert len(found)==1
  bounds=[lb[0]-rb[1],lb[1]-rb[0]];saved=found[0]
  numerical_errors.extend(abs(x-Decimal(str(y))) for x,y in zip(bounds,saved["conditional_expected_difference_bounds"]))
  assert saved["zero_included"]==(bounds[0]<=0<=bounds[1])
 assert max(numerical_errors)<Decimal("1e-12")
 for ref in list(report["references"].values())+report["evidence"]:
  data=Path(ref["path"]).read_bytes()
  assert len(data)==ref["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==ref["sha256"]
 assert report["components"]==12 and report["component_error"]==.05/12 and len(report["contrasts"])==6
 for key in ("historical_scores_rerun","observed_scores_changed","biological_generalization_intervals","unconditional_historical_interval_admission","other_endpoint_uncertainty_admitted","failed_factorial_cells_repaired","publication_ready"):assert report[key] is False
 print(json.dumps(dict(status="independent_native_four_cell_readback_passed",decimal_precision=80,methods=4,contrasts=6,count_endpoint_and_neighbor_conditions=16,max_numerical_error=str(max(numerical_errors)),log_historical_bindings=[row["native_log_historically_hash_bound"] for row in report["methods"]],checked_cells=checked),sort_keys=True))
